answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure and preserve energy by accelerating east in nearly level, steady flight, widening its lateral offset from surviving B0100 and the southeastbound enemy-missile tracks rather than turning back after its earlier missile engagement and B0200’s removal.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive the missile exchange by extending southeast in a sustained accelerating descent, using repeated hard banks while opening vertical separation below both southeastbound enemy missiles and continuing away from B0100 after B0200 becomes inactive and A0200’s earlier missile disappears.
